lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots exhibit a semi-regular spacing along the longitudinal axis of the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the high-luminance blobs, particularly evident in the mid-flank region where they form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the lateral flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition between upper-edge illumination and lower-edge shadowing.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of dark, vertical linear markings or possible healed indentations are visible immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
